What the brief shows as positive: the coin is alive, it's up about 85x over 30 minutes, it has 31 buyers and 9.68 SOL of buying in the last 15 minutes, and the pool holds 789 SOL of depth, so a $20 ticket would have little price impact.

But the demand signal is mostly operator activity. Post-graduation buying was 695 SOL from 24 buyers, with the top five accounting for 99.5% of it, and a bundle share of 1.0. Recent flow is roughly balanced (9.68 SOL in, 8.47 out, net +1.21), and the 15-minute return is just +0.3%, so the price is flat, not rising. Sellers (27) nearly match buyers (31), and the drawdown from the 30-minute high is zero only because the high was set minutes ago.

That pattern fits an operator-backed coin that has already done its pumping and is now holding. The brief gives no evidence of organic buyers arriving, and the 85x run is the classic setup for a distribution phase. Operator-class coins have been roughly break-even on average, and a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost makes break-even a loss for us.

Recommendation: skip. There is no honest case that real demand will persist for the next 30-6
